claims.text: EPO level < 500 mU/mL: ESAs (recombinant human EPO or darbepoetin) ± G-CSF;
claims.quote: If the level is less than 500 mU/mL, erythropoiesis-stimulating agents, such as recombinant human erythropoietin or darbepoetin, may be administered with or without granulocyte colony-stimulating factor.

claims.text: G-CSF doesn't appear to improve survival but may be synergistic w ESAs (erythroid response in 40% to 60%).
claims.quote: Granulocyte colony-stimulating factor does not appear to improve survival but may have a synergistic effect with erythropoiesis-stimulating agents, resulting in an erythroid response in 40% to 60% of patients.
